lessons.title: चतुराई और समस्या समाधान: read → notice → explain → use
lessons.objective: Learner can understand, explain and use चतुराई और समस्या समाधान in speech or writing.
teach: Introduce चतुराई और समस्या समाधान through a short original example connected to everyday life.
Ask the learner what they notice before explaining the formal idea.
Model how to find evidence in the text or situation.
Guide the learner to answer using complete, meaningful language.
Remove prompts and ask for an independent response.

worked_example.prompt: Use an original mini-example to demonstrate चतुराई और समस्या समाधान.
worked_example.method: Notice the clue, explain what it means, connect it to the idea, and express the conclusion clearly.

lessons.checkpoint: Explain चतुराई और समस्या समाधान and create one original example.
lessons.mastery_signal: Accurate understanding + evidence/reasoning + clear independent expression.

items.question: When working with the chapter idea 'चतुराई और समस्या समाधान', which response shows the strongest understanding?
options: Give an answer and support it with a relevant clue or example.
Repeat the question as the answer.
Guess without using any evidence.
Copy an unrelated sentence.
items.explanation: Strong language learning connects an answer to a clue, example, or reason.

items.question: Explain 'चतुराई और समस्या समाधान' in your own words and give an original example.
items.answer: A strong response explains चतुराई और समस्या समाधान accurately and uses an original, relevant example.

items.question: Use the idea of 'चतुराई और समस्या समाधान' in a short real-life speaking or writing situation.
items.expected_response: The learner should use चतुराई और समस्या समाधान accurately in a new context and communicate the idea clearly.

items.question: What is the best way to show mastery of 'चतुर चित्रकार'?
options: Use the important ideas independently in a new situation and explain the reasoning.
Finish every activity without checking understanding.
Memorise the chapter title only.
Repeat one worked example exactly.
items.explanation: Mastery requires independent understanding and transfer, not completion or copying.

items.question: Which idea from 'चतुर चित्रकार' would you teach to a younger learner first, and why?
items.answer: Any defensible answer is acceptable if it identifies a foundational idea and gives a logical reason.

interactive_activities.title: Read, notice, retell
interactive_activities.instructions: Use an original short passage or teacher-created example connected to 'चतुर चित्रकार'. Identify a clue related to चतुराई और समस्या समाधान, then retell the important idea in your own words.

interactive_activities.title: Use the language
interactive_activities.instructions: Role-play a familiar situation in which पात्रों के गुण is useful. The learner must speak or write independently.

interactive_activities.title: Make your own example
interactive_activities.instructions: Create a short original example showing सीख. Explain why it demonstrates the concept.

misconception_remediation.diagnostic: Ask the learner to explain the idea and solve a near-example without hints.
repair: Identify the exact concept or prerequisite that is missing.
Return to one concrete, familiar example.
Think aloud and contrast the incorrect idea with the correct idea.
Ask the learner to explain the correction in their own words.
Reassess before moving to the next concept.
misconception_remediation.exit_criterion: Two consecutive accurate responses with an independent explanation.

critical_conditions: Learner can explain the key idea without copying.
Learner can solve or respond to an unfamiliar example.
mastery_policy.on_failure: Do not simply unlock the next chapter. Route the learner to the weakest concept/prerequisite, reteach, practise and reassess.
mastery_policy.on_mastery: Unlock spaced retrieval and cumulative review.

spaced_retrieval.rule: Use mixed retrieval; increase difficulty after correct independent recall; re-enter remediation after repeated failure.
